t: How is it going? Ah, I envy you so much! Day-to-day life of the heroes must be so exciting.

I've heard about heroic adventures. People say a lot of noble heroes died in their pursuit of a mythical reward. But there's nothing you can't handle, right?

Then here's a task for you. Complete Heroic Adventures five times.
Excellent! Another day, another feat! Keep up the good work!
How is it going? Ah, I envy you so much! Day-to-day life of the heroes must be so exciting.
Excellent! Another day, another feat! Keep up the good work!

There's nothing like a good fight for you, heroes, eh?

Your task is to defeat your opponent in 6x6 combat ten times.
Complete 7 Heroic Feats and return to Zinaida Krichalkina for reward.

Hey, noble hero! You seem bored! I have a task just for to test your bravery!

Ten feats, no more, no less! And something very valuable to reward you. You'll find it useful in your adventures. It's the Encyclopedia of Minerals and Herbs! Are you interested?
No, you've come too soon. I've been counting your feats!

One, two, three, four... Right, here are all the feats, just as I asked. Isn't it good to feel so important?

Here is your reward!

I've heard about heroic adventures. People say a lot of noble heroes died in their pursuit of a mythical reward. But there's nothing you can't handle, right?

Then here's a task for you. Complete Heroic Adventures five times.

There's nothing like a good fight for you, heroes, eh?

Your task is to defeat your opponent in 6x6 combat ten times.
Complete 7 Heroic Feats and return to Valya Skomorokhova for reward.

Hey, noble hero! You seem bored! I have a task just for to test your bravery!

Ten feats, no more, no less! And something very valuable to reward you. You'll find it useful in your adventures. It's the Encyclopedia of Minerals and Herbs! Are you interested?
No, you've come too soon. I've been counting your feats!

One, two, three, four... Right, here are all the feats, just as I asked. Isn't it good to feel so important?

Here is your reward!
Talk to Zinaida Krichalkina in Nezebgrad to accept the offer.
Find Zinaida Krichalkina and ask her about the runes.

There you are! I knew you'd be interested. I've got an order to help all lagging Imperial heroes catch up! Complete one of my Not a Day without a Feat quests, and you will get a chance to obtain level 8 Runes at a very low price!

You will have only one chance to do so. Let's go for it!
Talk to Valya Skomorokhova in Novograd to accept the offer.
Find Valya Skomorokhova and ask about the runes.

There you are! I knew you'd be interested. The League needs its heroes! Complete one of my Not a Day without a Feat quests, and you will get a chance to obtain level 8 Runes at a very low price!

You will have only one chance to do so. Let's go for it!
Complete the Pledge of Dueling quest

Well, well. Let me take a look at you.

Hm, sorry, you don't like anything special. I should give you something simple to do.

Listen, do what everyone else does every day. Kill a Shadow Foe. It's a simple task that can show me you're ready to move forward.
Wonderful! Here is your reward! Come back tomorrow – there's more to be done.
Complete the Pledge of Eulogy quest

Let's continue!

There is safety in numbers. If you are already in a guild, you know that.

The Free Traders agree. We ourselves often employ the services of mercenary guilds which guard our mines, caravans, and banks. So give your allies their due, make a speech!
Here, you've earned it! Come back tomorrow!

How is it going, hero? All work and no play?

How about a little entertainment? You need to take a break now and then – heroes must rest sometimes. So this is your task for today: play Goblinball with your friends, have some fun!
Complete the Pledge of Punishment quest

So, back to work? For now, we'll continue to give you simple tasks to weed out those who are not willing to keep busy at all times. Back to the guild!

Every guild must prove its capabilities by its actions. Such as eliminating the most dangerous enemies. That's why I expect you to fulfill the Pledge of Punishment. Prove that you can be relied on.
You're strong! Come back tomorrow – we'll think of something to keep you busy.

You have proved your loyalty to your guild, but what about your country?

Every warrior must remember where their path began. When did you last visit the place where you received your first instructions? We want you to return there and provide whatever assistance is needed.
Keep it up! You can take a break, see you tomorrow.
Win a fight in Novograd Arena

It's time to spill the first blood!

Each capital has an Arena. There's always someone ready for a challenge. The Servants of the Light will even resurrect you for free. Those are perfect conditions for a fight.

Go and score a victory.
Have you spilled blood in the arena?
What a fight! Let's do that again sometime. Take a break – tomorrow you'll get another task.
Complete the Pledge of Fervor quest

Let's get this guild business over with.

It's simple: by proving to me you are ready to help your guild, you are proving your willingness to help the Free Traders.

So today you will carry out a task that might require some effort. I'm talking about the Pledge of Fervor.
Keep it up! Come back tomorrow, we'll give you a new task.

It's time for some serious deeds.

If you heard about the events in Irdrich, you know that we've managed to establish a stable connection to the Illusory World. You can now bring whatever you need from that world. And the Tekyan and Aviaks are in the process of relocating... So you can't say that world doesn't exist.

But there are still those who want to ruin this idyll. I'm talking about the Aviak anarchists, of course. It's time they paid for everything. Go to the Illusory World and bring us the Heavenly Fire!
Have you dealt with the anarchists?
That's what I'm talking about! I'll see you tomorrow.

Oh, those trips through time and time paradoxes!

You know, if the League hadn't managed to mine enough meteorite ore on Kirah, their fleet would have been destroyed by the astral demons. But Eniel delivered enough boxes to the Kanian Archipelagos for them to build a lot of ships.

So this is your next task: travel to the past and help the League with the ore.
That's the stuff! Here, I'll see you tomorrow.
Complete the On the Attack! quest

Eljune is an important place for the Free Traders. Lots of meetings and other important events take place there, lots of deals are being made as we speak.
But there's a problem called the Bloody Outpost.

The Imperial forces are still stationed there, and they stop anyone who has any connection to the League. It's creating many problems.

I believe it's time to replace the Outpost's owner – hopefully the League will be more lenient towards our operations than the Empire. Well, you know what to do.
What a feat! You’ve earned this reward!
Complete the We Weren't Born Yesterday! quest

Brave League soldiers are fighting the remaining demon forces on Yazes!

Yes, demons are still a threat... And they have a... lair? nest? base? on that cursed island. I don't know. They just keep coming.

In any event, the League and Imperial soldiers will be there for a while.

But the morale is dropping! We need to do something about that, to ensure that the astral trading routes near Yasker are secure. Your exploits inspire many, so go there and perform some kind of feat. Shoot an Octulhu from a cannon, for example.
Complete the Power of Thought quest

Sarn's cultists.

Some believe they are just madmen who want us all to be devoured by demons.

On the other hand, they have some interesting technologies. Cloning. Portal magic. Death rays!

We'd like to get our hands on some of that... But alas, we've been unsuccessful in that regard.

Perhaps you'll have more luck. We know that the cultists are trying to hide something on the Twilight Isle. Go there and try to steal the blueprints with the help of the allied Wormfaces.
Oh, you're done already? The world won't forget that! Here, come back tomorrow.

Are you confused?

There are enemy Wormfaces and allied Wormfaces. There are enemy Draconids and allied Draconids. There are enemy cultists and... yes, correct! Allied cultists.

Well, the world is not black and white. And after the events you took part in, it has gotten even more complicated. Some still stick to the old ways, but others... might have looked at you and decided to act differently.

Where am I going with this? On the Wandering Island, we managed to reach an agreement with Sarn's cultists. Some of them work with the Demonologists. So one of the local cultists, Nomarkh Ankh, decided to arrange Spark races. And races mean profit.

We want you to participate and win! So go there and do everything you can to win the race.
Must have been a nice race!

We'll take a break from our extremely important missions.

Let's talk about your tasks. What's the most important thing for a hero?
Besides the runes, it's equipment, of course. Various artifacts you can find in the deep layers of the Astral. I hope you travel to the Astral often?

Let's see! Visit an astral allod, defeat the enemies there and report back to me.
Oh, I wish I could go on adventures like that... Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow!
Complete the Secrets from the Depths of the Earth quest

Let's get back to something really important. Together with Nihaz, lots of new things came to this world, such as the ability to create personal allods. There are many of those now.

The Free Traders are taking advantage of that, of course. We started working on a truly grandiose project – a real continent.

Alas, it's not going that well. To understand why we're running into so many issues, we need samples of the minerals from one of our newly created allods, the Cradle. I assign this task to you.
Amazing places, aren't those? Well, this is just the beginning...
Complete the Dionic Games: Chariot Race quest

It turns out races are quite profitable.

I'm talking about bets, of course. And it also turns out that the most spectacular races take place at the Dionic Games arranged by the Aoidoi.

Well, good for them. We profit from those quite a bit. Of course, you understand what's expected of you – you need to travel there, take part in the race, and win the first place.

Just choose time carefully: races are held according to schedule, so try not to pick the busiest time!
I hope you're here for your gold medal.
What a hero! You've earned this reward! Don't forget to come back tomorrow.

You probably know that the history of the Free Traders is tied to the meteorite that allowed us to create astral ships that travel between allods and transport goods.

When the secret of astral travel became generally available, ancient blades forged from meteorite steel were melted down, and more ships were built every year.

But I digress. There was a war for the meteorite on Kirah. I want to know if we can affect the history to ensure that the League gets more meteorite. Perhaps then we'll have more ships in the present?

Your task is to help the League gain an advantage in the battle for the mine.
Thank you on behalf of all geologists!
Complete the Helping the Ghost Hunters: Preventive Hit quest

The Free Traders sympathize with various adventure seekers who hunt for treasures in the ruins of old cities. We are happy to buy their discoveries from them – to resell them later at a higher price.

But there are adventurers who cross the line... Such as the famous Treasure Seekers known for their raiding and pillaging. The so-called Gray Prince's minions!

It's time we reminded them that the Free Traders have a long reach. And you'll be our weapon. Find those four scoundrels that are hiding on the Isle of Revelation and deal with them.
A worthy undertaking! Go now, I need to come up with something for you to do tomorrow...

There's someone in Sarnaut the Free Traders are extremely interested in. She's known as Klavdia Kalugina.

The problem is, we know very little about her. And we'd like to know as much as possible.

But she's not easy to get close to. She never stays long in one place. It's some sorcery.

Listen to me carefully. I'll give you a special device. You'll go to Tka-Rik's Cave and complete her tasks. Then you'll report to me. You don't need to do anything. Just stay close to her for some time, and you'll do us a great favor.
Wonderful! I'll prepare a special task for tomorrow!
Complete the Death to Our Foes! quest

Today you and I will help some cultists.

Semer Knef wrote to me recently. They are ready to share some of their technologies with us if we lend them our support.

The enemy Wormfaces who serve Nihaz, and Agrus's Draconids – who are even more vicious – have sent reinforcements to the Wandering Island... It sounds like they are trying to capture the Palace Square and the path that leads to the Seal of Darkness.

They must be stopped. Use the cultist forces to seize control of the square.
I have no doubts about your strength now. But I still have a few special tasks prepared...

As for the Battlefields, we have an incentive program from the Tycoons. Haven't you heard?

Well, what matters is it works. Bets on combats, broadcasts via Astralophone.

We need to support our colleagues! Especially since my brother is handling it.

So go to the Battlefields. Try to win, of course.
I never doubted you! Take your reward and come back tomorrow!
Complete the Dionic Games: Steeplechase quest

You're good at fighting...

What about running? Like an obstacle course? Yes, we want to negotiate a contract regarding Dionic Games broadcasts.

So we can attract more viewers. So it's nice of you to show how impressive a victory can be.

So today's task is for you to travel to the Dionic Archipelago and take part in the race.
You're quick on your feet! Keep it up.
Complete the Grain of the Gold from the Past quest

Time is an interesting element.

Even the Great Mages have a hard time understanding what it is, why it only flows forward and how it can be affected.

One of the tools that can influence it is the Observatory. Another is the Whirlpool of Time.

While we can't get to the Observatory, we've been studying the Whirlpool for some time.

We know it causes curious anomalies on Kirah – Time Storm and Crocosaur Hunt, which in turn create Elementals of the Odds and Crocosaurs – creatures from the distant past.

You can get actual rewards from them – grains, carats, ounces, and pounds of Gold from the Past. The exchange rate isn't that great today, but nevertheless it's an interesting phenomenon.

Bring me one such grain.

I already talked about that, but now I should tell you more: after their defeat, the demon cultists split into two groups. One is headed by Semer Knef. He's an Arisen who is willing to work with us. He's providing assistance to Maya Voronina. We also got something from him...

But the radical ones are a different matter. Those who want to see the world burn. They are led by Lada Grusova, Aristarkh Zlobin, and Lawrence Weirdin. They still have control of Yazes Shards.
Zlobin and Weirdin decided to move Twilight Isle away from the Isle of Revelation.

To make it possible, they started restoring targets carried by astral Octulhus.

We can't let that happen, of course. So your mission is simple: destroy the targets by completing the Wormfaces' task.
Complete the Dionic Games: Gladiator Battle quest

You know, people are getting bored with usual combats. They demand something new: for girls to fight in the mud, and for runes to be unequipped during fights. In short, they want something new, something unusual.

So we have another option: gladiator fights on the Ammer Arena. Why? Give someone a spear, sword, or a throwing axe. An interesting idea.

Let's try our idea with bets.

Well, you just need to set an example.
You are very good at fighting. Good job!
Complete the Grain of Experience quest

We'll continue to study the Whirlpool of Time.

Just think about it – portals to the past created by architects existed only for a moment... but the Whirlpool has functioned for years.

I received reports about artifact research. Surprisingly enough, each temporal anomaly contains a significant amount of destructive energy.

There's something connecting the Astral, time... and astral demons.

But I won't bore you with metaphysics. We're mainly interested in theories that can turn into profit. Someone is willing to pay for the Grans of Experience. Earn some.
Complete the Twilight Isle Cannons quest

It looks like our activities on Twilight Isle made the cultists unhappy.

They contacted their demons... Those who didn't join Ollum.

And sent a lot of them to defend their targets.

Well, we'll have to shoot them down. Grab a cannon and get rid of those pesky creatures.

Our marathon is nearing its end – don't expect the tasks to be easy!

June Catacombs are located deep inside the Gipat mountains. They still hold many treasures, but there's never a shortage of treasure hunters.

It's time for you to have a go at it. Or are you a frequent visitor already?

At any rate, you need to go there and try to get at least one treasure.
If only these things happened every day. Here, take it!

Let's have some fun before the final day? We've accomplished so much already... You must have noticed that we often ask you to take part in different competitions...

Well, they are profitable. Any competition can be bet on.

As you know, the first famous race took place on Kirah. It's time for you to go there – pick your best mount and try to win the race among the sand dunes and storms.
What, the race is over already?
That was fun... Don't forget about the task tomorrow!
Defeat all strong enemies in the Observatory on low difficulty

This is the final day... I have prepared something special – we want to understand how the Observatory works.

I'll give you a small device... you just need to take it with you – you won't have to do anything with it.

But to understand how the Observatory works, you'll have to defeat all enemies it will send at you next week.

Of course, Cosmos mustn't find out. So don't tell anyone about our little task.
Oh, you've finished your last task... Well, that was fun! Hopefully we’ll meet again! I'll report your success, don't worry.

Oh, so you decided to do it?

Well, let's start small. With something simple.

Of course, everyone wants to kill dragons. What if you need to do something small – but every day? Yes, I'm talking about a Shadow Foe. Prove to me that you can do something every day.
Wonderful! Here is your reward! Come back tomorrow – there's more to be done.
Complete the Pledge of Eulogy quest

So what's next?

Ah, right. Guilds. Have you realized that it's hard to survive in this world alone? Heh.

The Free Traders agree. We ourselves often employ the services of mercenary guilds which guard our mines, caravans, and banks! So don't forget your brothers, heh.
Here, you've earned it! Come back tomorrow!

So what, hero? Am I boring you?

Alright, that will pass. My tasks will be easy for the time being. We all need to rest sometimes, after all. What's the best way to have fun? Physical activities!

It's time to play some Goblinball, so go and sign up!
Complete the Pledge of Punishment quest

Back to business, eh? We don't want to overwhelm anyone – so we're trying to see if you're willing to do a little every day.

Every guild must prove it's not a gathering of weaklings, but a team of real warriors! What do we need? We need you to eliminate the most dangerous enemies. That's why I expect you to fulfill the Pledge of Punishment. Prove that you can be relied on.
You're strong! Come back tomorrow – we'll think of something to keep you busy.
Win a fight in Nezebgrad Arena

Well, it's time to kick some ass, yeah?!

Listen up. Each capital has an Arena. There's always someone ready for a challenge. The Servants of the Light will even resurrect you for free. Those are perfect conditions for a fight.

So go there and beat the hell out of someone.
Well? Have you spilled blood in the arena?
What a fight! Let's do that again sometime. Take a break – tomorrow you'll get another task.
Complete the Pledge of Fervor quest

It's simple: by proving to me you are ready to help your guild, you are proving your willingness to help the Free Traders.

Keep it up! Come back tomorrow, we'll give you a new task.

That's what I'm talking about! I'll see you tomorrow.

Complete the Storm the Isle! quest

But I won't bore you with all the details. We're mainly interested in theories that can turn into profit. Someone is willing to pay for the Grans of Experience. So bring them here.
Complete the Twilight Isle Cannons quest

It looks like our activities on Twilight Isle made the cultists unhappy.

They contacted their demons... Those who didn't join Ollum.

And sent a lot of them to defend their targets.

Well, we'll have to shoot them down. Grab a cannon and get rid of those pesky creatures.

Our marathon is nearing its end – don't expect the tasks to be easy!

June Catacombs are located deep inside the Gipat mountains. They still hold many treasures, but there's never a shortage of treasure hunters.

It's time for you to have a go at it. Or are you a frequent visitor already?

At any rate, you need to go there and try to get at least one treasure.
If only these things happened every day. Here, take it!

Let's have some fun before the final day? We've accomplished so much already... You must have noticed that we often ask you to take part in different competitions...

Well, they are profitable. Any competition can be bet on.

As you know, the first famous race took place on Kirah. It's time for you to go there – pick your best mount and try to win the race among the sand dunes and storms.
What, the race is over already?
That was fun... Don't forget about the task tomorrow!
Defeat all strong enemies in the Observatory on low difficulty

This is the final day... I have prepared something special – we want to understand how the Observatory works.

I'll give you a small device... you just need to take it with you – you won't have to do anything with it.

But to understand how the Observatory works, you'll have to defeat all enemies it will send at you next week.

Of course, Cosmos mustn't find out. So don't tell anyone about our little task.
Oh, you've finished your last task... Well, that was fun! Hopefully we’ll meet again! I'll report your success, don't worry.

What's there to explain?

 There's war on our doorstep. Demons, League, some other arch... ah, Tep take it!

 Anyway, war makes some people rich.

 The Free Traders supply the best weapons. We sell them. But if you give some dolt an astral cannon, they can only hammer nails with it.

 So you need to find someone skilled to make us some profit and do good for the world.

 So we arranged a Marathon – 30 days and 30 quests, and those can do it will receive a reward!

And don't be afraid - we're not so cruel as to make you do everything! You can skip a couple of difficult quests - you will still receive the best reward as long as you have enough coins!

It's easy – just come to me every day and pick up a task, and I'll give you a coin! In the end, you will buy prizes and be happy. Just keep in mind that the task can be completed only on the same day – we do not tolerate delays!

We prepared a special task for each day, so don't skip them!
Come and look – I'm selling those rewards here! But only the most determined one will get the best reward!
h: What will I get as a reward?

t:
Huh, the Marathon is over, hero!

Buy your prizes, and if you couldn't participate – don't despair and wait for the next race!

You have proved your loyalty to your guild, but what about your country?

In short, every warrior must remember where their path began. When did you last visit the place where you received your first instructions? We want you to return there and provide whatever assistance is needed.
Keep it up! You can take a break, see you tomorrow.
Win Skirmishes three times and complete an Astral Allod three times to receive the opportunity to change the Order.

So you want to join a different Order? Well, there is no blood feud between them... For now. It is quite simple. But first you must prove that your intentions are solid. How? It's easy.

You must win Skirmishes three times and complete an Astral Allod three times. And another Order will welcome you!
Well, your intentions seem very solid and true. Now you can join another Order.

Complete 5 heroic adventures without letting a single group member die. The adventure will not be completed if somebody dies, but the progress will not be reset.

Kill 3 Octulhus in the open Astral without flying into the hangar and without breaking the ship.
So, are you readyready to search for parts? These parts are harder to find - some heroes got them off the tentacles of giant Octulhus! By the way, I've never seen them. I wonder how scary they are?
How is it going? Have you foundfound anything?
Wow! These are well-preserved parts. Keep up the good work, and soon your armor will be even better!

Complete the quest "Finding Parts: Astral Sea Cadet" 21 times or "Finding Parts: Astral Wolf" 14 times.

Hi! I see you've masteredmastered the full power of combat armor? Do you want even more power? More room for augmentations and more armor health.

You just need to get some components for upgrades. You may find them during your astral travels.

I'll only accept one quest per day - take your time, mechanisms are a delicate matter.
How is it going? I can't wait to upgrade your armor!
You've foundfound them all! Well, hold on to your hat! I'll make you something amazing.
Meet with Diana Gadget in Yasker's Tower.

Aho, friend!

My name is Diana, but my friends call me Gadget.

I heard you ownown armor. You can now buy mana batteries, emergency kits and memory modules from me and not from my fellow countryman Gaal-Bran the GloomySlap the Furious.

I'm also an expert in improving combat mechanisms. I will make your armor even more powerful.

Come! I'll be waiting.
Aho! It's really you! Come on, show me your armor. Let's modify it?

Take part in ten 6x6 rating combats and report to Gaal-Bran the Gloomy in Novograd or Slap the Furious in Yasker’s Tower.

You must complete this quest to keep your rating!

If you fail to complete this quest, your rating will decrease at 5:00 server time.

Right, that escape took a while! At least we have a car and new... maybe not friends, but not enemies either.

Let's discuss what happened, and then we'll get to the city...
Let's go already, I'm dead tired.
Wow, we can finally take a break... You probably need to find that friend you wanted to see? I hope you succeed. The city is pretty big...
Introduce yourself to the Great Mage Simon

Ah, there you are! Oh, wow! Wow, you look... Alright, you can tell me about your wild adventures later.

Let's not waste any time. Look around, and once you're done, talk to me. We'll go meet Simon before he falls asleep in his garden...
The official part is over, now let's talk business...
Question the heads of groups of scientists

Let's start with those who are directly related to what happened - the scientists.

Before the incident, they all worked together, but now... Anyway, you'll see.

They housed them here, near the square, but to show their disdain for each other, they all stay in different corners.

Find out what you can.
Hmm... I was hoping to hear more than that. Fine, I guess we have work to do...

The incident? I'm sure it was sabotage...

I haven't told anyone about this, but before we ran... I mean, evacuated from the site, I noticed that an important part was missing... The Chronophone! What is a Chronophone? Well, the thing that makes traveling through time and space possible! It influences the strings that comprise reality!

The Chronophone was stolen, I'm certain of it. Perhaps that's what caused the eruption... But it's possible the eruption happened before it was stolen...
h: Greetings! I was sent here to learn more about the incident...

t: There were only our four groups at the site. So it must be one of them. Who could it be? My people are out. Zem? Unlikely. I've known Negus Kheket for a while, none of them need it. The elves? It's possible, but I'm not sure what their motives would be. It's unlike them to sabotage their own work... And Herbert was so enthusiastic. There's one possibility: this Zarida with Catherina backing her. Catherina also wants to build a portal to another world, possibly using her Eclipse. That's why the Chronophone was stolen
h: What do you think caused it?

t:
It's strange that you've never heard of me... I've worked on one of the Gates projects before. Without false modesty, I admit that the creator of the Gates-2 and Gates-3 largely used my work as a basis.

The last few years weren't kind to me. The launch of the Gates-2 was even worse... To begin with, we teleported the Great Mage Zayan from the past, which almost caused our entire timeline to collapse! And then... we decided to prevent Tep's Plague... But made a mistake in calculations and teleported it here. So Gates-2 are currently in quarantine, and I've been answering very awkward questions at the Committee for years.

And only when the construction of Gates-3 was underway, I was allowed to come here, to Suslanger... And now we have problems again!
h: Remind me again - who are you?

t:
He couldn't keep it together and spilled the beans!

The experiment was unique! A real field test. Just as Yaver Turing suggested. If no one can tell the AI from a real boy, then it is truly alive.

I guess, it was a success. No one could tell them apart, you say? Yuppie! It's time for a doctorate!
h: I know everything about the mechanical pioneer.

t: Make a wish and make the jinn free

You know, I wanted to ask one last favor of you.

It looks like this jinn has been trapped in this lamp for a while. And he's sick of fulfilling people's wishes, so he's twisting them.

I talked to the guys, and we decided to free him. But I'm afraid of what he might do. Maybe you could help us?
Shall we rub the lamp? Just don't give in to temptation! Be like us! We're the best examples!
So we meet again. Thank you again for freeing me. Now I can be anywhere without limitations.

As you understand, I have nothing to tell you. The jinn already told you everything.

The girl that came here from another time? Wow. Let me know how this story ends.

I'm going to find this map, then I'll go to the desert and search for Nezeb's treasures!

Give Eladia my regards.
Thank you again for your help!
Instead of useless suspicions - let me help you. I'll start my investigation among the pioneers and find out who had a hand in it.
Talk to the pioneers, help them, and ask about the events

I'm talking about the pioneers, of course.

There's a pioneer camp in the area, and since no one can leave right now, they have been stuck here.

They are running back and forth, so I won't be surprised if they noticed something. Ask them. Help them with their pioneer things if you have to - that should make them more talkative.
Have you learned anything from the pioneers?
That's not much. But I think we have one more option left.
Find an Ambrosia Crocodile and bring a piece of it to Alice

Oh, hello! You're here to help me again? I hope you recognized me in my pioneer uniform? Or you forgot how we ran away from the Orcs? Ah, that's all in the past now.

I'm trying to study the consequences of the eruption of the Ambrosia.

So I decided to feed one of the local creatures with Ambrosia for experimental purposes.

I picked a crocodile in the local river.

And the Ambrosia caused the crocodile to grow in size and turned it rabid.

It won't let people cross the bridge.

Please get rid of it and bring back whatever is left so I can study it.
Well? Did you find the crocodile?
Thank you for your help! I'm almost certain it will help my research.
Catch the camels conjured by the jinn

Good afternoon, my friend!

There's a matter I wanted to discuss... We have a problem. I took a swim in the lake and found a pitcher. I thought it was an antique so I wanted to take it to the museum. I tried to clean it, but when I rubbed it, smoke started pouring out, and this... jinn appeared. And he says, "What's your name, boy?" And I say, "Volka." He says, "I shall be your loyal slave, Volka. I can fulfill any wish, perform any miracle!"

Then I say, "Sir Jinn, we live in a progressive society - we don't have slaves here, and we don't need miracles either. We pioneers do everything ourselves using our skills and knowledge."

But the jinn won't relent, says I freed him so he has to obey me. We tried to get rid of him, to explain - nothing works. Then jinn tried to "guess" our wishes. Created a camel caravan. What does a simple pioneer need camels for? I said we'd hand them over to the city committee, let the workers use them. The jinn got angry and chased the camels off, now they are running all over the city. Please gather the camels. Help us!
Thank you, we'll take them to the committee, maybe we'll even get a badge!
